Good afternoon, boys and girls. My 16 is Cherry King. I am from the USA, but now I am 17 China. My father and mother are here( 在这里 ), too. I am a 18 school student. I am in Class Three. Grade Seven. I have some good 19 at school. They are very friendly( 友好的 ) and 20 to me. I like them very much. Please look( 看 ) here. What is this? Oh, it is my 21 . My mother buys the jacket for me. The 22 of it is red and yellow. And what's that? It's a cup. Is it 23 cup, too? No, it is my brother's. It is blue. He has 24 cups. One is blue and three are white. I have one cup. It's green.

35 ． Which ( 哪一个 ) can be the title for the passage ( 文章的标题 )?
Do you know English people's family names? Everyone （每个人） has a family name. But what does it mean （意思是） ? What do family names come from?

First, some family names are from the place （地点） of people's homes. If a man lives on or near a hill, his family name may be Hill. In England, people's family names may be Wood or Lake, because they live near the wood or lake （树林或湖 ) . Second, family names are from a person's job. If a person is a cook, he may be Mr. Cook. Third, many people get their family names from their fathers' given names. If you hear the family name 'Jackson', you will know that he is the son of Jack.

A ． people's homes B ． people's habits

39 ． How many kinds of family names are mentioned （提到） ?
40 ． What's the best title of the passage?

I'm in Xingzhi Middle School. Students in my class 64 (be) very nice. I like to play( 玩 ) with them. Peter is in Class One, Grade Seven. He's my classmate. I can 65 (spell) his name, P-E-T-E-R. He's 13, too. He likes black very much. He has a black phone, three black 66 (ruler) and a black eraser. And 325-2145 is 67 (he) telephone number. Cathy is my friend. She's 68 English girl. Her telephone number is 365-2458.
